readout_other: 32-channel intracortical multi-unit recording; spike sorting; PSTH; spike time tiling coefficient correlation
direction_notes: Firing in response to peripheral electrical stimulation increased after ultrasound at all SRFs relative to sham; pairwise correlation decreased at 10 and 50 Hz and increased at 75, 100 and 125 Hz.

target.label: S1HL region of the rat brain

timing.protocol_description: Nested pulsing: 200 us tone bursts at PRF 3 kHz (burst duty cycle 60%) gated at a sonication repetition frequency (SRF) of 10, 50, 75, 100 or 125 Hz at 60% duty cycle (total duty cycle 36%), delivered for five minutes between peripheral electrical stimulation epochs.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Thirty-two adult male Wistar rats were studied according to a protocol approved by the Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee of Carnegie Mellon University.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: In each animal, two ultrasound sessions and a sham session were performed in a random order before euthanasia.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: Ultrasound was delivered in pulses using a single element focused transducer with a concave surface (AT31529, Blatek Industries, Inc., USA), with an outer diameter of 25.4 mm, fundamental frequency f<sub>0</sub> of 0.5 MHz, and a nominal focal distance of 38 mm.
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.manufacturer: Ultrasound was delivered in pulses using a single element focused transducer with a concave surface (AT31529, Blatek Industries, Inc., USA), with an outer diameter of 25.4 mm, fundamental frequency f<sub>0</sub> of 0.5 MHz, and a nominal focal distance of 38 mm.
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.model: Ultrasound was delivered in pulses using a single element focused transducer with a concave surface (AT31529, Blatek Industries, Inc., USA), with an outer diameter of 25.4 mm, fundamental frequency f<sub>0</sub> of 0.5 MHz, and a nominal focal distance of 38 mm.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_duration_ms: The tone burst duration was 200 µs.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: Together these generated the fundamental frequency $\mathsf { f } _ { 0 }$ of 500 kHz, the PRF of 3 kHz, and the SRF of 10-125 Hz as portrayed in Figure 2A.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.duty_cycle_pct: Ultrasound is delivered with a burst duty cycle of 60%.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: Following this, ultrasound stimulation was delivered for five minutes.

flags.reason: No pressure or intensity is reported; the text only notes the paradigm did not reach 131 kPa.
Each animal received two ultrasound sessions and one sham session in random order; 2 counts ultrasound sessions only.
Sham sonication to a different brain region equidistant from auditory cortex was used to account for indirect auditory effects; not a listed vocabulary term.
Total duty cycle 36% (burst duty cycle 60% x 60%); 0.2 ms burst times 3 kHz PRF is consistent with the 60% burst duty cycle.
